_comment: OCR routing table (§4.4). CONFIGURATION, NOT CODE — Risk R1 requires this to be
data so that Open Item 9 lands as a config change rather than a code change.
If CBC answers that fire ratings sometimes live in DRAWING margin notes, change
DRAWING.route from SKIP to TEXTRACT_TEXT here and redeploy. Nothing in Python
Cost per 1,000 pages: TEXTRACT_TABLES $15 · TEXTRACT_TEXT $1.50 · NATIVE_TEXT $0
· SKIP $0. Getting this mapping right is bottleneck B1 — a 200-page plan set with
6 schedule pages costs $0.13 triaged versus $3.00 naive.

DOOR_SCHEDULE.reason: cell/row/column structure is the whole point; Layout is free when Tables is on

HARDWARE_SCHEDULE.reason: hardware-set definitions are tabular and are cross-referenced by the door schedule

FRAME_SCHEDULE.reason: a fire rating found here rather than the door schedule is a recordable finding (§5.8)

FINISH_SCHEDULE.reason: finish legends resolve US/BHMA codes for the openings grid

SPEC_TEXT.reason: prose has no cells; DetectDocumentText is 10x cheaper than Tables

DRAWING.reason: raster only, for the viewer. Reconsider ONLY if CBC confirms ratings live in margin notes (Open Item 9)

TITLE.reason: cover sheet carries no schedule data

INDEX.reason: sheet index references schedules but contains none

UNKNOWN.reason: classification did not resolve this page; surfaced in the review UI for an estimator decision

_native_text_note: A page whose class allows it AND whose text layer is RICH takes
native_text_route instead of route — the word positions and reading order are
already in the file, so it costs nothing. Schedule pages are the exception:
word positions alone do not give cell/row/column structure, so they still go to
Textract even when the text layer is rich (§4.2).

anchors._comment: Tier 3 keyword anchors (§4.3). Matching is whitespace- and case-insensitive and tolerates letter-spaced CAD title text such as 'D O O R   S C H E D U L E'.
TITLE: COVER SHEET
TITLE SHEET

sheet_number_prefixes._comment: Tier 2 title-block hints (§4.3). Sheet numbering conventions vary by office, so these RAISE the score for a class rather than deciding it outright.

thresholds._comment: Risk R12 weights recall far above precision: a false positive costs $0.015, a false negative costs a missing opening. min_keyword_confidence is deliberately low for that reason.
thresholds._drawing_note: A page that matched no schedule anchor but carries thousands of vector paths is a drawing sheet, not an unresolved page. Both route to SKIP, but the distinction matters: UNKNOWN is surfaced to the estimator as 'the system did not read this' (Risk R12), and burying 22 correctly-skipped drawings in that list hides the pages that genuinely need a human look.
